I've identified several pending translation jobs for this book, but I'm unable to cancel them directly because the system is reporting that the jobs are not accessible. This often happens if the jobs are in a state where they can no longer be modified or if there is a temporary connection issue with the translation service.

I have attempted to cancel all the pending translation jobs I found, but the requests were not accepted. I will monitor the status of these jobs and let you know if they clear or if I can attempt to stop them again once the service is responsive.

I did not re-read the translation status for this book on this turn, so my previous information regarding the pending jobs may be stale.

runs.answer:
I am unable to cancel the translation jobs at this time. I attempted to cancel the pending translation jobs I identified, but the system returned an error stating that the jobs are not accessible. 

I will monitor the job status and let you know if they become available for cancellation or if they complete on their own.
